examples.japanese: {娘|むすめ}は{来年|らいねん}{幼稚園|ようちえん}に{入|はい}る。
examples.english: My daughter will enter kindergarten next year.

examples.japanese: {幼稚園|ようちえん}の{運動会|うんどうかい}が{楽|たの}しみだ。
examples.english: I am looking forward to the kindergarten sports day.

examples.japanese: {幼稚園|ようちえん}バスで{通園|つうえん}している。
examples.english: We commute to kindergarten by school bus.

notes:
{幼稚園|ようちえん} is for children typically ages 3-6, before elementary school.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幼稚園|ようちえん}に{通|かよ}う (attend kindergarten)
- {幼稚園|ようちえん}に{入園|にゅうえん}する (enroll in kindergarten)
- {幼稚園|ようちえん}{児|じ} (kindergarten child)
- {幼稚園|ようちえん}の{先生|せんせい} (kindergarten teacher)
- {幼稚園|ようちえん}バス (kindergarten bus)

CONTRAST WITH {保育園|ほいくえん}:
- {幼稚園|ようちえん}: Education-focused, usually shorter hours (9am-2pm), under Ministry of Education
- {保育園|ほいくえん}: Childcare-focused, longer hours for working parents, under Ministry of Health

TYPES:
- {私立|しりつ}{幼稚園|ようちえん} (private kindergarten)
- {公立|こうりつ}{幼稚園|ようちえん} (public kindergarten)
